svg.title: Ila rejects the pump contractor's call as Riju traces paid works onto a road crossing the pond.
svg.desc: The incoming call carries the same fictional pump-wheel seal reserved on the completion certificates. Ila tells the pump contractor not now without hiding the evidence. Riju follows the parcel towards a mapped road that crosses the surviving pond.
svg.text: Page 17, panel 6 · Wide dusk shot linking Ila's phone, certificates and the distant pond line

text.tspan: Ila refuses quiet contractor pressure as the records
lead back to the impossible pond-road.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
